periods.label: 被强音碎击吹飞的国王
titles: strongest formal fighter of Dragunov's underground arena

status.condition: blown into the upper stands with the other fighters

relationships.rai-saiyo: Opponent who overpowers his giant club with Forzato Smash.

periods.summary: King is Dragunov arena's strongest fighter, a giant man whose Gigantification ability can enlarge his already huge body and club up to fivefold. He attacks the Hagure sisters after their coordinated sweep, but Rai blocks him. King sees the overhead weak point of Rai's spinning-mass technique and tries to crush the axis, only for Rai to turn the blade and release Forzato Smash, a pressure-wave tsunami that blows King and the rest of the standing mob into the upper seats.

key_events.summary: Attempts to crush Rai's spinning attack but is defeated by Forzato Smash.
